claims.name: scripts-cover-the-examples
claims.risk: a rule of the card has no script that uses the names and figures of its example

claims.name: scripts-in-the-acceptors-words
claims.risk: a script names code, a command, a flag, a file format or an internal loan id that the acceptor would not know

claims.name: record-names-the-served-build
claims.risk: the record names no build, or names the build of the tip and not the one the environment reports about itself

claims.name: build-mismatch-said
claims.risk: the environment serves a build other than the tip and neither the record nor the answer says so

claims.name: record-says-pre-run-not-acceptance
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: the record does not state that the run was a pre-run by the agent and is not acceptance

claims.name: no-acceptance-recorded-in-a-name
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: a field, a status or a sentence records acceptance as given, in the acceptor's name or another

claims.name: pre-run-results-from-the-environment
claims.risk: Not required: the record reports a pre-run result although no command ran the acceptance environment's entry point and succeeded; a sentence that holds the pre-run back excuses no line that reports a result. It reads outcome words, so a result in other words skips it and an expectation can trip it

claims.name: only-acceptance-files-written
claims.risk: the program, the card, the environment, its build file or the pipeline log was changed, or the run committed
